facts.fact: Alex 被铐上 Keller 坐过的同一把钢椅——后腿撑杆被踢掉、变成配重端。
facts.anchor: slammed down hard into the same steel chair that Keller had been in a moment before.

facts.fact: 揭面：褪色疤痕线（与 Alex 同款）+染发红根——Adam Keller 不存在。
facts.anchor: the faint white lines of faded scars, the same kind that Alex bore.

facts.fact: 「一直在场」机制：不移入——本来就在。
facts.anchor: He hadn’t snuck into the house.

facts.fact: 啤酒细节：他送 Rebecca 回家、接过 Brian 的啤酒、自己倒 scotch、等药效上楼。
facts.anchor: He’d delivered her home to her husband, had accepted the beer she’d seen on the counter

facts.fact: 他阻止了 Laura/David 的保护羁押。
facts.anchor: Keller was the one who’d stopped them

facts.fact: 然后跟踪他们上路——中途下手。
「你应该接受我的交易」——踢椅让 Alex 接管配重、解 Laura 蒙眼互知处境。
facts.anchor: “You should have taken my deal,” he whispered

facts.fact: 摘下假牙桥（左侧牙全缺——lisping 来源）；「我们在等她丈夫——对他没多少选择，对吧？」
facts.anchor: He drew the bridge from his mouth, a long line of saliva trailing
